name: Hokuriku Electric Industry Co.,Ltd.
summary: Hokuriku Electric Industry Co.,Ltd. engages in the development, manufacturing, and sale of electronic components in Japan and internationally. The company offers sensors, such as hydrogen, force, pressure, humidity, barometric pressure, and seat; piezoelectric sounder and buzzers; electronic circuit function modules; chip fixed and network resistors; sulfur-resistant and surge-resistant chip fixed resistors, high-power chip Fixed Resistors, high-precision chip fixed resistors; fuse resistors, chip fuses, ESD protectors; NTC thermistor; chip metal plate fixed resistors; tactile switches; variable resistors; Metal Oxide Film Fixed Resistor; and printed circuit boards; as well as IoT solutions.…
